description: Create a new discussion topic in a course.

delayed_post_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime to schedule the topic for future posting

is_announcement.description: When true, requests an announcement instead of a discussion topic. Canvas silently downgrades this to a plain discussion topic (no error) if the caller lacks announcement permission in the course — check the response's own `is_announcement` field rather than assuming the request was honored.

message.description: Body text of the discussion (supports HTML)

require_initial_post.description: Require students to post before seeing replies

name: create_discussion
title: Create Discussion
